record.bible_text: How doth the city<WH05892> sit<WH03427><WTH8804> solitary<WH0910>, <FI>that was<Fi> full<WH07227> of people<WH05971>! <FI>how<Fi> is she become as a widow<WH0490>! she <FI>that was<Fi> great<WH07227> among the nations<WH01471>, <FI>and<Fi> princess<WH08282> among the provinces<WH04082>, <FI>how<Fi> is she become tributary<WH04522>!

She weepeth<WH01058><WTH8799> sore<WH01058><WTH8800> in the night<WH03915>, and her tears<WH01832> <FI>are<Fi> on her cheeks<WH03895>: among all her lovers<WH0157><WTH8802> she hath none to comfort<WH05162><WTH8764> <FI>her<Fi> : all her friends<WH07453> have dealt treacherously<WH0898><WTH8804> with her, they are become her enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>.

Judah<WH03063> is gone into captivity<WH01540><WTH8804> because of affliction<WH06040>, and because of great<WH07230> servitude<WH05656>: she dwelleth<WH03427><WTH8804> among the heathen<WH01471>, she findeth<WH04672><WTH8804> no rest<WH04494>: all her persecutors<WH07291><WTH8802> overtook<WH05381><WTH8689> her between the straits<WH04712>. <RF>because of great...: Heb. for the greatness of servitude<Rf>

The ways<WH01870> of Zion<WH06726> do mourn<WH057>, because none come<WH0935><WTH8802> to the solemn feasts<WH04150>: all her gates<WH08179> are desolate<WH08074><WTH8802>: her priests<WH03548> sigh<WH0584><WTH8737>, her virgins<WH01330> are afflicted<WH03013><WTH8737>, and she <FI>is<Fi> in bitterness<WH04843><WTH8804>.

Her adversaries<WH06862> are the chief<WH07218>, her enemies<WH0341><WTH8802> prosper<WH07951><WTH8804>; for the LORD<WH03068> hath afflicted<WH03013><WTH8689> her for the multitude<WH07230> of her transgressions<WH06588>: her children<WH05768> are gone<WH01980><WTH8804> into captivity<WH07628> before<WH06440> the enemy<WH06862>.

And from the daughter<WH01323> of Zion<WH06726> all her beauty<WH01926> is departed<WH03318><WTH8799>: her princes<WH08269> are become like harts<WH0354> <FI>that<Fi> find<WH04672><WTH8804> no pasture<WH04829>, and they are gone<WH03212><WTH8799> without strength<WH03581> before<WH06440> the pursuer<WH07291><WTH8802>.

Jerusalem<WH03389> remembered<WH02142><WTH8804> in the days<WH03117> of her affliction<WH06040> and of her miseries<WH04788> all her pleasant things<WH04262> that she had in the days<WH03117> of old<WH06924>, when her people<WH05971> fell<WH05307><WTH8800> into the hand<WH03027> of the enemy<WH06862>, and none did help<WH05826><WTH8802> her: the adversaries<WH06862> saw<WH07200><WTH8804> her, <FI>and<Fi> did mock<WH07832><WTH8804> at her sabbaths<WH04868>. <RF>pleasant: or, desirable<Rf>

Jerusalem<WH03389> hath grievously<WH02399> sinned<WH02398><WTH8804>; therefore she is removed<WH05206>: all that honoured<WH03513><WTH8764> her despise<WH02107><WTH8689> her, because they have seen<WH07200><WTH8804> her nakedness<WH06172>: yea, she sigheth<WH0584><WTH8738>, and turneth<WH07725><WTH8799> backward<WH0268>. <RF>is...: Heb. is become a removing, or, wandering<Rf>

Her filthiness<WH02932> <FI>is<Fi> in her skirts<WH07757>; she remembereth<WH02142><WTH8804> not her last end<WH0319>; therefore she came down<WH03381><WTH8799> wonderfully<WH06382>: she had no comforter<WH05162><WTH8764>. O LORD<WH03068>, behold<WH07200><WTH8798> my affliction<WH06040>: for the enemy<WH0341><WTH8802> hath magnified<WH01431><WTH8689> <FI>himself<Fi> .

The adversary<WH06862> hath spread out<WH06566><WTH8804> his hand<WH03027> upon all her pleasant things<WH04261>: for she hath seen<WH07200><WTH8804> <FI>that<Fi> the heathen<WH01471> entered<WH0935><WTH8804> into her sanctuary<WH04720>, whom thou didst command<WH06680><WTH8765> <FI>that<Fi> they should not enter<WH0935><WTH8799> into thy congregation<WH06951>. <RF>pleasant: or, desirable<Rf>

All her people<WH05971> sigh<WH0584><WTH8737>, they seek<WH01245><WTH8764> bread<WH03899>; they have given<WH05414><WTH8804> their pleasant things<WH04261><WTH8675><WH04262> for meat<WH0400> to relieve<WH07725><WTH8687> the soul<WH05315>: see<WH07200><WTH8798>, O LORD<WH03068>, and consider<WH05027><WTH8685>; for I am become vile<WH02151><WTH8802>. <RF>to...: or, to make the soul to come again<Rf><CM>

<FI> Is it<Fi> nothing to you, all ye that pass<WH05674><WTH8802> by<WH01870>? behold<WH05027><WTH8685>, and see<WH07200><WTH8798> if there be<WH03426> any sorrow<WH04341> like unto my sorrow<WH04341>, which is done<WH05953><WTH8776> unto me, wherewith the LORD<WH03068> hath afflicted<WH03013><WTH8689> <FI>me<Fi> in the day<WH03117> of his fierce<WH02740> anger<WH0639>. <RF>Is it...: or, It is nothing<Rf> <RF>pass by: Heb. pass by the way?<Rf>

From above<WH04791> hath he sent<WH07971><WTH8804> fire<WH0784> into my bones<WH06106>, and it prevaileth<WH07287><WTH8799> against them: he hath spread<WH06566><WTH8804> a net<WH07568> for my feet<WH07272>, he hath turned<WH07725><WTH8689> me back<WH0268>: he hath made<WH05414><WTH8804> me desolate<WH08074><WTH8802> <FI>and<Fi> faint<WH01739> all the day<WH03117>.

The yoke<WH05923> of my transgressions<WH06588> is bound<WH08244><WTH8738> by his hand<WH03027>: they are wreathed<WH08276><WTH8691>, <FI>and<Fi> come up<WH05927><WTH8804> upon my neck<WH06677>: he hath made my strength<WH03581> to fall<WH03782><WTH8689>, the Lord<WH0136> hath delivered<WH05414><WTH8804> me into <FI>their<Fi> hands<WH03027>, <FI>from whom<Fi> I am not able<WH03201><WTH8799> to rise up<WH06965><WTH8800>.

The Lord<WH0136> hath trodden under foot<WH05541><WTH8765> all my mighty<WH047> <FI>men<Fi> in the midst<WH07130> of me: he hath called<WH07121><WTH8804> an assembly<WH04150> against me to crush<WH07665><WTH8800> my young men<WH0970>: the Lord<WH0136> hath trodden<WH01869><WTH8804> the virgin<WH01330>, the daughter<WH01323> of Judah<WH03063>, <FI>as<Fi> in a winepress<WH01660>. <RF>the virgin...: or, the winepress of the virgin, etc<Rf>

For these <FI>things<Fi> I weep<WH01058><WTH8802>; mine eye<WH05869>, mine eye<WH05869> runneth down<WH03381><WTH8802> with water<WH04325>, because the comforter<WH05162><WTH8764> that should relieve<WH07725><WTH8688> my soul<WH05315> is far<WH07368><WTH8804> from me: my children<WH01121> are desolate<WH08074><WTH8802>, because the enemy<WH0341><WTH8802> prevailed<WH01396><WTH8804>. <RF>relieve: Heb. bring back<Rf>

Zion<WH06726> spreadeth forth<WH06566><WTH8765> her hands<WH03027>, <FI>and there is<Fi> none to comfort<WH05162><WTH8764> her: the LORD<WH03068> hath commanded<WH06680><WTH8765> concerning Jacob<WH03290>, <FI>that<Fi> his adversaries<WH06862> <FI> should be<Fi> round about<WH05439> him: Jerusalem<WH03389> is as a menstruous woman<WH05079> among them.

The LORD<WH03068> is righteous<WH06662>; for I have rebelled<WH04784><WTH8804> against his commandment<WH06310>: hear<WH08085><WTH8798>, I pray you, all people<WH05971>, and behold<WH07200><WTH8798> my sorrow<WH04341>: my virgins<WH01330> and my young men<WH0970> are gone<WH01980><WTH8804> into captivity<WH07628>. <RF>commandment: Heb. mouth<Rf>

I called<WH07121><WTH8804> for my lovers<WH0157><WTH8764>, <FI>but<Fi> they deceived<WH07411><WTH8765> me: my priests<WH03548> and mine elders<WH02205> gave up the ghost<WH01478><WTH8804> in the city<WH05892>, while they sought<WH01245><WTH8765> their meat<WH0400> to relieve<WH07725><WTH8686> their souls<WH05315>.

Behold<WH07200><WTH8798>, O LORD<WH03068>; for I <FI>am<Fi> in distress<WH06887><WTH8804>: my bowels<WH04578> are troubled<WH02560><WTH8777>; mine heart<WH03820> is turned<WH02015><WTH8738> within<WH07130> me; for I have grievously<WH04784><WTH8800> rebelled<WH04784><WTH8804>: abroad<WH02351> the sword<WH02719> bereaveth<WH07921><WTH8765>, at home<WH01004> <FI>there is<Fi> as death<WH04194>.

They have heard<WH08085><WTH8804> that I sigh<WH0584><WTH8737>: <FI>there is<Fi> none to comfort<WH05162><WTH8764> me: all mine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802> have heard<WH08085><WTH8804> of my trouble<WH07451>; they are glad<WH07797><WTH8804> that thou hast done<WH06213><WTH8804> <FI>it<Fi> : thou wilt bring<WH0935><WTH8689> the day<WH03117> <FI>that<Fi> thou hast called<WH07121><WTH8804>, and they shall be like<WH03644> unto me. <RF>called: or, proclaimed<Rf>

Let all their wickedness<WH07451> come<WH0935><WTH8799> before<WH06440> thee; and do<WH05953><WTH8778> unto them, as thou hast done<WH05953><WTH8782> unto me for all my transgressions<WH06588>: for my sighs<WH0585> <FI>are<Fi> many<WH07227>, and my heart<WH03820> <FI>is<Fi> faint<WH01742>.<CM>
